workModeStandaloneDescription: Only for standalone use on mobile phone.
workModeStandaloneDescriptionMore: By using the Reqable mobile app exclusively, an independent CA certificate will be generated. Also, you can add other collaborative devices later as needed.
workModeCollaborationDescription: Works together with the Reqable desktop app.
workModeCollaborationDescriptionMore: Add a desktop device as the collaborative device, share CA certificates, and use Reqable desktop app to analyze and manipulate mobile network traffic.
workModeOnlyTrafficDescription: Capture and analyze traffic via MITM proxy.
workModeAllDescription: I need all the features above.
workModeTips: Selecting a mode will only affect the initial configuration, and you can still use other features.
